title: EXPO / City Pavilion
techniques: Shared 90×64m open-roof pavilion: 24 furnished booths, cafes, toilets, entry/exit, information,32 city buildings and streets
Hardware-instanced articulated human crowd:13 body parts per person, CPU aisle-following walk cycles,24–1200 visitors
Dijkstra destination routes over an obstacle-safe aisle graph with corner facility detours and animated amber flow markers
Day/night lighting: directional shadows, two shadowed pavilion spots,14 local night lights, emissive windows, HDR bloom, ACES and SSAO
Native HiDPI fixed100% default, orthographic map, orbit/pan/zoom, exterior cutaway and manual resolution recovery
limitations: CPU crowd simulation, no compute simulation or person-to-person collision avoidance
Wall-frame timing includes CPU/GPU/scheduling; no GPU timestamps or hardware ray tracing
Route distances are graph estimates; not an accessibility certification
HTML projected map labels; touch pinch zoom not implemented
Quick tunnel is temporary and changes when restarted

defaultResolution.backingFormula: round(CSS width × devicePixelRatio × scale) × round(CSS height × devicePixelRatio × scale)
